description: This file contains Python functions for extracting and formatting version information from a provided data structure, including handling different formats of version data and generating version strings.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Extracts a version list [major, minor, patch] from the input info, handling different formats and defaulting missing parts.

methods.name: GetVersionString
methods.description: Generates a dot-separated version string from the info by utilizing GetVersion.
